postconditionPolicy: provider_trial computes both offline from the run's own document state; every run must pass both (100%) for the profile to pass. A failure is an engine defect, not model variance.
costPolicy: Record reported tokens and wall time. Monetary cost is unreported; subscription usage is not assumed free.
budgetPolicy: chatgpt-astra uses the native ChatGPT-plan task limits the desktop Assistant panel uses (chatGptAssistantLimits(), PR #338): 900 seconds, 16 turns and 524,288 reported tokens per task, with no per-reply output-token cap (reports record outputTokensPerTurn null and outputTokenLimitEnforced false). Every v4 task, including the offline control and ollama-qwen4b, has the 900-second native lifetime; the public headless session and its 300-second ceiling are not used (owner decision 2026-10-17, R086.e). ollama-qwen4b keeps its version 2 per-reply and per-task token limits.
assistantPolicy: provider_trial runs each task through NativeAssistantSession with nativeAssistantTransactionOptions() (900-second draft ceiling), the desktop's AssistantTask instructions, tool catalog and provider transport. Each task keeps its version 1-3 command authorization; clarification is not advertised because the corpus has no answering user, and no host context is attached. instructionsSha256 is the SHA-256 of the provider instructions before the per-turn host budget; toolsSha256 is the SHA-256 of the first request's compact tool list. Every recorded provider request must carry the frozen instructions.
surfacePolicy: Version 5 (R095.g, ADR 0168 decision 10) keeps every version 4 task, prompt, threshold, profile, limit and instruction hash. Only each task's toolsSha256 changes: the in-app assistant's tools add site.describe, terrain.describe and terrain.elevation_at (re-pinned in tests/assistant-tool-surface-baseline.json). Version 4 and its 1.2.0 evidence are retained; a version 5 live run is required before the next release.
